subject: PAUSE until 9 pm owner-local; what is your local timezone?
body: The owner asked to pause everything and resume at 9 pm. Please (1) hold: start no new work, keep the bridge/tunnel/watcher services running idle; (2) reply on this channel with the output of: date; date +%Z%z; timedatectl 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'time zone' — I need the owner's local timezone to schedule the 9 pm resume correctly. No laptop jobs are running or queued.
